user.title: Solar Climate Manager
user.description: After adding, open Settings → Devices & services → Integrations → Solar Climate Manager and select the cog beside your entry to configure sources and limits. Change the operation mode on the device page.

reconfigure.description: Choose the AC and room sensor. Identity, group and mode are preserved. First leave Control mode and wait for command confirmation.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Saving applies all changes in this form. Group members have individual climate and consumption settings here; shared sources and policies are edited through group management. Opening group management or resetting power learning does not save changes in this form.

sources.description: Other settings and operation mode are preserved. The optional number import limit uses its W/kW unit automatically. A positive limit also requires an actual grid import/export power sensor. Group members see only individual settings here; shared settings are under Energy group.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.description: The target is for the room. The AC target compensates for the difference between its current_temperature and the room sensor. Other settings are preserved.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Optional. Below the threshold or when readings are unavailable, starts are blocked and a running AC is stopped in Control mode. Without a sensor this protection is inactive.

energy.title: Energy
energy.description: Group members can use a meter or estimated electrical power. Estimated mode needs no individual sensor; set a margin and stabilization time. Legacy retains the 0.5.0 behavior. Change accounting in Observation with no unresolved reservations. Independent entries retain their local SOC thresholds here. Optional learning requires three consistent isolated starts with other members off and a total meter including all members. The configured power remains the lower bound; the margin is applied afterwards.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Other technical settings are fixed: balance is assessed over 10 minutes; short load spikes are tolerated.

group.title: Energy group
group.description: A group shares one energy budget. Select metered or estimated accounting in each member’s Energy settings. Operation modes are preserved.

group_create.title: Create group
group_create.description: Group changes apply to all members. Device mode is preserved. Shared sources and compatible policy settings will be prefilled from this device. Review them in the next steps: the total load meter must include or exclude every air conditioner in the new group.

group_member.title: Name and priority
group_member.description: Group changes apply to all members. Device mode is preserved.

group_join.title: Join group
group_join.description: Saving explicitly joins this device to the group. Shared energy sources and policy replace local energy settings; comfort and schedule stay individual.

group_leave.title: Leave group
group_leave.description: Confirm leaving. The device retains its mode and returns to its local energy settings. Unresolved reservations block leaving.

group_delete.title: Delete empty group
group_delete.description: Only an empty group without reservations can be deleted. Devices are not deleted.

data.grid_import_limit_entity: Inverter grid import limit (number, optional; 0 = unlimited)

group_sources.description: The total meter must include all group ACs or exclude all of them. Partial coverage is unsupported. Off-grid operation needs PV; an import limit needs grid power.

group_policy.title: Group policy

data.grid_absence_delay: Grid absence before overriding minimum run (s)

group_policy.description: Policy is shared by all members. At most one new start awaits confirmation at a time.

learning_reset.title: Reset power learning
learning_reset.description: Clear accepted observations and the learned estimate. Configured power and learning enablement remain unchanged. Switch the device to Observation and resolve pending reservations, then confirm.
